    for kw in headline_keywords:

            found.append((item['ref'], kw, item['text'][:200]))

print('=== Keyword hits in article ===')

print('\n=== Fig. 5 first 30 rows ===')
for i, r in enumerate(fig5[:30]):
    print(i+1, r)

# Check if there is any correlation value or p-value reported as a headline
print('\n=== Searching for numeric correlation or agreement metrics ===')
for item in article:
    txt = item.get('text','')
    # look for patterns like r=0.XX, R2=, correlation of XX%
    matches = re.findall(r'[rR]\s*[=:]\s*[-]?\d+\.?\d*', txt)
    if matches:
        print(item['ref'], matches, txt[:200])
    matches2 = re.findall(r'\d+\s*%\s*(?:correlation|agreement|accuracy|concordance)', txt, re.IGNORECASE)
    if matches2:
        print(item['ref'], matches2, txt[:200])
